== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Queen]] [[Leah]] I, also known as [[Queen]] [[Leah]] the First, is the monarch of [[Damasca]] and a member of its royal family. A [[Ragnarus Traveler]], she is credited with the near-total unification of her nation and the breaking of the [[Ragnarus the Crimson Vault|Ragnarus]] seal, which tied the [[Territory]] to her lineage. Her historical legacy includes defeating the final [[Elysian Incarnation]] in a one-on-one fight. Physically, she is distinguished by heterochromia, possessing one blue eye and one glowing red eye. She has been seen wearing red and gold attire, a silver circlet, and a [[silver chain]] with a white [[stone]] on her wrist. In her capacity as a leader, she has wielded the [[Lightning Spear]] and has demonstrated the ability to command other [[Damascan Travelers]] once the threat of the [[Incarnations]] is removed.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|During the first year of her reign, [[Queen]] [[Leah]] I established herself as the current monarch. She is a figure with ancestral ties known to [[Valin]] and serves as a client for whom [[Overlord Indirial]] conducts business. Throughout the records, she is identified and mentioned as [[Queen]] [[Leah]] the First.}}
